text:
Anya (PM): Quick sync — we need to lock DP recruitment + eval criteria for the private preview. Target: 6–8 partners across enterprise/mid-market/ai-native. 4 week runway. Thoughts?
Diego (Eng): +1 on runway. Do we have a hard list of must-have integrations (VPC, KMS, audit logs)?
Anya (PM): Must-have: VPC + KMS for at least 3 enterprise partners. Audit logs can be gated as "opt-in" for the rest. Also need model/latency SLAs documented.
Priya (ProdOps): For recruitment, I'd add a section for infra readiness: allowed IP ranges, approved SSO flows. We should require a 2-week environment prep window.
Ben (ML): Eval criteria suggestion: quality (human eval on 200 prompt pairs), latency (p99 under X ms), cost delta vs baseline. Propose simple rubric:

```
QUALITY: pass if >85% parity on core prompt set
LATENCY: p99 < 1200ms
COST: <1.3x token cost vs hosted baseline
STABILITY: no >3 production errors/week
```

Ruth (CS): That works, but partners care about outcome metrics. Add "task completion" and "time-to-first-value" as qualitative measures.
Anya (PM): Good call. Let's add "time-to-first-value" as a success KPI: partner can run 5 end-to-end requests within 2 hours of onboarding.
Diego (Eng): On scope: we should avoid shipping custom model variants for the preview. Offer pinned model versions and a fallback plan. This keeps rollout simpler.
Priya (ProdOps): Agreed. Also, recruitment message should call out NDA + data usage terms. I'll draft template. @Ruth can we offer $10k credits or support hours as incentive?
Ruth (CS): $10k credits + 10h onboarding support seems right for enterprise. For ai-native startups, offer extended logs + 1:1 onboarding.
Ben (ML): For the human eval, can we get partners to run a short A/B internally? We'll provide a script and scoring sheet.
Anya (PM): We'll produce an "eval harness" repo with scripts + sample prompts. Link will go in the intake doc.
jira-bot: created REDWOOD-1999 "DP private preview intake + eval harness" assigned to Anya (PM)
Diego (Eng): Operationally, need canary rollout plan: first two partners on dedicated capacity, next ones on shared. Also auto-fallback to smaller model if capacity stretched.
Priya (ProdOps): I'll add that to runbook. Also set telemetry hooks: prompt id, model version, latency, error code, token counts. Must be enabled by default for partners.
Ruth (CS): Feedback loop cadence: weekly 30-min check-ins for first 2 weeks, then biweekly. Also a short post-session survey (3 Qs) after each check-in.
Anya (PM): Launch criteria checklist draft:
- 6 partners signed
- 3 enterprise partners with VPC+KMS onboarded
- Eval harness run and quality gate passed by at least 4 partners
- Rollout runbook completed + alerts configured
- NDA + contracting complete
If any 2 of the above fail, delay launch.
Ben (ML): Agree but reduce "fail" tolerance to 1 for security items (KMS/NDA).
Anya (PM): Noted. Security items are gating. I'll update wording: security items are mandatory.
Diego (Eng): One more ask: collect a short set of prompts that represent their heavy tail. We'll use that for batching/kv cache tuning.
Ruth (CS): I'll ask partners for 10 representative prompts each (anonymized). We'll include privacy checklist.
Priya (ProdOps): Timeline: recruitment messaging live tomorrow, intake form open for 2 weeks, onboarding staggered starting 3/1. Is that realistic?
Anya (PM): Yes. Priya draft intake form + NDA template by EOD. Diego + Ben to prepare eval harness and runbook by Friday. Ruth to confirm incentives and initial partner list.
Diego (Eng): I'll put up a PR with runbook skeleton and canary plan.
Ben (ML): I'll prep evaluation scripts and a simple dashboard for parity metrics.
Ruth (CS): I'll ping top 10 partners and post shortlist in this thread by EOD.
Anya (PM): Perfect. Final note — keep asks small per partner. We want quick wins and clear success signals. :thumbsup:
Priya (ProdOps): ack
Diego (Eng): ack
Ben (ML): ack
Ruth (CS): ack
